subcategory_text: Implement secure-by-design development environments for AI work, including isolated GPU/training sandboxes, scoped access to datasets, and traceability of compute and data use.
implementation_examples: Run training jobs in isolated network segments with data-egress controls
Capture compute and data-access logs for every training run
Use ephemeral training environments that are destroyed after each run
assessment_objectives: Determine whether AI development environments are isolated and access-controlled.
Determine whether compute and data-use are logged per run.
